title: Global Partners Marks National Coffee Day with a Free Cup for Bee’s Knees Benefits™ Members
summary: Loyalty app users at Alltown Fresh®, Jiffy Mart, XtraMart and the company's other convenience market brands can claim a complimentary coffee on September
body_markdown:
***Loyalty app users at Alltown Fresh®, Jiffy Mart, XtraMart and the company’s other convenience market brands can claim a complimentary coffee on September 29***


**Newton, Mass. (September 29, 2026) –** Your cup of joe is on them! Global Partners, a leading independent liquid energy supplier and retail operator, is marking National Coffee Day by picking up the tab for its guests. On Tuesday, September 29, every member of Bee’s Knees Benefits, the official loyalty app for Global’s convenience markets, can claim a free 16-ounce hot or iced coffee at participating locations nationwide. From the daily Alltown Fresh® regular to the Jiffy Mart commuter to the traveler pulling into an XtraMart mid-road trip, the offer gives loyalty members an easy, welcome perk on one of the year’s most popular beverage holidays.


“Coffee is part of the daily rhythm for so many of our guests, and National Coffee Day gives us a chance to celebrate that with them,” said Jac Moskalik, Head of Food, Innovation and Strategy at Global Partners. “This is a day made for coffee lovers, and we’re celebrating with a free cup for everyone who walks through our doors. For new guests, it’s a first taste of what Bee’s Knees Benefits delivers all year long.”


To claim this offer, Bee’s Knees Benefits members simply present the app barcode at checkout on September 29. Bee’s Knees Benefits is available at more than 300 locations. Members collect points on every dollar spent in-store and every gallon of fuel pumped, gain access to exclusive savings, and can earn and redeem rewards on everyday purchases including fresh food, coffee, snacks, and fuel.


Available at Alltown Fresh and select locations, Global’s coffee program features freshly brewed, small-batch, responsibly sourced beans, delivering premium flavor for guests on the move. Hot or iced, each cup is made to keep up with a busy day: fast, fresh, and full of flavor. The free coffee offer can be redeemed at Alltown Fresh, Alltown™, Honey Farms, Honey Farms Market™, XtraMart, Jiffy Mart, Wheels®, Mr. Mike’s®, and Millers.


**About Global Partners LP:**


*Building on a legacy that began more than 90 years ago, Global Partners has evolved into a Fortune 500 company and industry-leading integrated owner, supplier, and operator of liquid energy terminals, fueling locations, and guest-focused retail experiences. Global operates or maintains dedicated storage at 54 liquid energy terminals—with connectivity to strategic rail, pipeline, and marine assets—spanning from Maine to Florida and into the U.S. Gulf States. Through this extensive network, the company distributes gasoline, distillates, residual oil, and renewable fuels to wholesalers, retailers, and commercial customers. In addition, Global has a large portfolio of owned, leased and/or supplied retail locations across the Northeast states, the Mid-Atlantic, and Texas, providing the fuels people need to keep them on the go at their unique guest-focused convenience destinations. Recognized as one of Fortune’s Most Admired Companies, Global Partners is embracing progress and diversifying to meet the needs of the energy transition.*


*Global, a master limited partnership, trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “GLP.” For additional information, visit *****[www.globalp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.globalp.com&esheet=54105440&newsitemid=20240806720223&lan=en-US&anchor=www.globalp.com&index=2&md5=357274df387d0d2f3059aa9cd4196f95) ***.***
